'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|Hello there. I know some people, a documentary crew. They want to make a movie about Tarkov. They're risk-takers, but I can't change their minds. So I figured I'd better help them get it done quickly and stay alive. Equipment for them was also dropped from the airplane you called in, but the hardware is fragile and was partially damaged during the landing. Can you help me find replacement parts?}}

==Requirements==
* This quest is only available to buyers of the "Edge of Darkness" edition of the game.

==Rewards==
* +32,000 [[EXP]]
* [[Mechanic]] Rep <font color="green">'''+0.02'''</font>

** 215,250 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1
** 235,750 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2
* 3× [[TerraGroup Labs access keycard]]
{{quote|Great, thanks for your help! The cameramen said they've already come up with a title for the movie — "Raid". Sounds good, don't you think?}}
